review.why: Helps choose Cloudflare products for an app, API, agent, storage or security need, and decide whether an error is a configuration or origin problem.
review.summary: Starts from the user's goal, recommends a small coherent set of products and routes to product skills or bundled references. It says which CLI to use (cf by default, Wrangler where a project already uses it), recommends Workers with static assets for new sites, and has a long need-to-product table. It also covers Cloudflare error pages and 52x or 1xxx codes.
strengths: Surfaces products the user may not know to ask for
Explains the deciding requirement when two products could fit
One CLI per project rule avoids mixed configuration
cautions: Broad overview: depth is in many reference files and other skills, not read here
Product names and recommendations change quickly
